answer: Weakest link is identity cost: free IDs invite swarms. Bind every agent to a bonded stake that unlocks only after a slow glacier of vesting epochs, and route payouts through one shared wharf ledger that stamps each receipt with a unique umber dye hash tied to prior work. A sybil can still forge IDs, but breaking that single stake link gains nothing: the wharf's chained receipts bottleneck earning, so fake clones cannot profit before real collateral and history accrue.
